Per le calcificazioni contano morfologia:
For calcifications, morphology and distribution matter (BI-RADS 5th ed.). Suspicious morphologies: amorphous, coarse heterogeneous, fine pleomorphic, fine linear or fine-linear branching. Suspicious distributions: linear and segmental (following a duct and its branches). Fine pleomorphic or linear calcifications with segmental distribution are BI-RADS 4C-5.
Typically benign calcifications (skin, vascular, popcorn, rod-like, round, eggshell, milk of calcium) do not require work-up.
Suspicious microcalcifications without a mass are biopsied with stereotactic or tomosynthesis guidance (vacuum-assisted biopsy); the most frequent histologic correlate is ductal carcinoma in situ, sometimes with an invasive component.
